**What the new cell is computed on:** 30 instances and K = 6 models per floor. The AUC filter kept 6 of 18 bootstrap, 6 of 6 seed and 6 of 12 hyperparameter retrainings. Its floor-b-by-background rows use 10 instances, K = 6.

**What changes for the paper** (k = 3, non-linear cells, German MLP excluded from the retraining ranges as before):
- **Seed floor:** the range becomes 0.40–0.88, down from 0.50–0.88; the new low is this cell (0.404). The bootstrap and hyperparameter ranges are unchanged.
- **Other floors:** the explainer and background ranges are unchanged, and the explainer floor is still above the background floor and all three retraining floors in every non-linear cell.
- **Paired Kernel against two backgrounds:** the paired difference excludes zero in 7 of 14 non-linear cells (5 higher, 2 lower), up from "7 of 13". The new cell is unresolved.
